BTSE has a simple vision: to be the connection between traditional finance and digital assets. We're looking for individuals who share our passion for digital assets and are eager to be part of a dynamic and forward-thinking team.
If you are ready to be at the forefront of the digital asset revolution, then BTSE is the place for you. Join us and help build the future of finance!
Job Responsibilities
PostgreSQL Database Administration & Optimization
Manage and maintain PostgreSQL databases across multiple production environments, ensuring high availability and optimal performance.
Design and implement database structures, backup and recovery strategies, and disaster recovery plans.
Monitor database health, identify performance bottlenecks, and fine-tune queries, indexes, and configurations for maximum efficiency.
Provide DBA support during critical business operations, including troubleshooting production issues and ensuring data integrity.
Automation & Security
Develop automation scripts to streamline database maintenance, deployment, and monitoring tasks.
Implement robust database security practices, including access control, encryption, and auditing.
Database Documentation & Collaboration
Maintain comprehensive documentation of database configurations, procedures, and best practices.
Work closely with cross-functional teams, providing database expertise and support for various projects.
Stay current with PostgreSQL and other relevant database technologies, recommending upgrades and improvements as needed.
Job Requirements
A minimum of 5 years of experience in PostgreSQL database administration, with proven expertise in managing large-scale databases in production environments.
In-depth knowledge of PostgreSQL architecture, performance tuning, and replication.
Strong experience with database backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning.
Proficiency in SQL and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) for automation and optimization.
Familiarity with database monitoring tools and practices to ensure proactive issue resolution.
Strong understanding of database security best practices and implementation.
Ability to work effectively under pressure, with a track record of handling critical production issues.
Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
Nice to Have
Experience with PostgreSQL extensions and tools (e.g., PostGIS, pg_partman, Patroni, PgBouncer).
Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP) and containerized environments (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
Experience with database automation and CI/CD pipelines.
Familiarity with other database systems such as MySQL or NoSQL databases.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive salary and benefits package
A fully remote work environment with flexible working hours
Opportunities for professional growth and development
Collaborative and inclusive company culture
Be part of the exciting and ever-evolving blockchain industry, with the opportunity to make a significant impact

description:

Amartha adalah perusahaan teknologi finansial terkemuka yang berfokus pada pemberdayaan perempuan pengusaha mikro di pedesaan melalui layanan keuangan inklusif. Kami percaya bahwa dengan memberikan akses keuangan yang lebih baik, kami dapat membantu meningkatkan kesejahteraan masyarakat dan menciptakan dampak sosial yang positif.

Bersedia ditempatkan di seluruh wilayah Nusa Tenggara Barat (area: Mataram, Lombok Barat, Lombok Tengah, Lombok Timur, Lombok Utara, Sumbawa, Sumbawa Barat, Dompu, Bima, dan Kota Bima).

Strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and Mandarin.
A proactive team player who is collaborative, adaptable, and eager to learn.

description:
About BTSE: BTSE Group is a global leader in fintech and blockchain technology, anchored by three core business pillars: Exchange, Payments, and Infrastructure Development. Serving over 100 corporate clients worldwide, we provide white-label exchange and payment solutions. Our offerings encompass everything from exchange infrastructure hosting and development to custody, wallets, payments, blockchain integration, trading, and more. We are looking for talented professionals in marketing, operations, customer support, and other departments. The roles offered may be on-site, remote, or hybrid, in collaboration with our local partner.
About The Opportunity: We are seeking a Cyber Security Operations Center (CSOC) Analyst with 3-4 years of experience in security monitoring, detection engineering, and incident response to join a lean, high-ownership security team at a cryptocurrency exchange. You will work closely with our MSSP and internal engineering team to close gaps between raw alerting and actual risk reduction — turning threat intel feeds into action, validating that our detections actually work, and helping build out new programs like insider threat monitoring. This is not a pure alert-queue role: you'll be expected to write and improve detection logic, document your work so it survives beyond you, and take ownership of incidents end-to-end rather than handing off after triage.
Responsibilities:
• Perform triage, analysis, and escalation of security alerts across SIEM, EDR/XDR, WAF, email security, and cloud log sources, coordinating with our MSSP where relevant.
• Own incidents end-to-end — triage through resolution through "what changed afterward" — and turn that work into documented playbooks and updated detection logic, not just closed tickets.
• Develop, tune, and validate SIEM detection rules (ES|QL/EQL/KQL or equivalent), including running detection validation exercises against existing use cases to confirm they actually fire.
• Convert threat intelligence feeds and scheduled hunting queries (e.g., lookalike domain alerts, anomalous auth events) from passive detection into defined, actionable response — closing the loop between "we saw it" and "we did something about it."
• Support the build-out of an insider threat monitoring program, including identity and privileged-access anomaly detection.
• Understand our detection tooling and log source pipelines (maintained day-to-day by our MSSP) well enough to confirm they're onboarded correctly and actually working — you're not expected to build or maintain this tooling yourself, but you need to be able to verify it.
• Track and report CSOC performance metrics (MTTD/MTTR, false-positive rates, MSSP SLA adherence) to support continuous improvement of operations.
• Write and maintain operational documentation, playbooks, and detection rule rationale so institutional knowledge isn't concentrated in one or two people.
• Contribute to automation of repetitive triage and enrichment work (scripting, workflow tools) to reduce manual toil across the team.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and regional partners, where Chinese language skills may be required.
Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 3-4 years of experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC) or equivalent security monitoring/detection engineering role.
• Hands-on experience with SIEM tools, including: 1. Detection rule and use case development, and the ability to reason about whether a rule actually detects what it claims to (detection validation mindset, not just rule-writing). 2. Query/rule-writing experience in ES|QL, EQL, KQL, or equivalent. 3. Alert triage, enrichment, and case management with ticketing systems. 4. Comfort reading raw logs (auth events, CloudTrail-style audit logs, process trees) without relying solely on pre-built dashboards.
• Working knowledge of Python or similar scripting for automation, log parsing, or extending existing tooling — enough to pick up and modify scripts someone else wrote, not build from scratch.
• Knowledge of common attack techniques, malware behavior, and network security principles, with familiarity mapping detections to MITRE ATT&CK.
• Familiarity with incident response frameworks (e.g., NIST, SANS) and a track record of writing playbooks or documentation from real incidents.
• Exposure to identity/IAM log analysis or insider threat / UEBA concepts is a strong plus, given active program build-out.
• Good understanding of cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and comfort across varied operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS).
Nice to Haves:
• Familiarity with atomic-level adversary emulation using Atomic Red Team or equivalent framework, for the purpose of validating that detections fire as expected.
• Effective communication and documentation skills.
• Chinese language proficiency (reading, writing, and/or speaking) is a strong advantage.
• Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, CompTIA Security+, CySA+, CEH, or similar) are desirable.
Perks & Benefits:
• Competitive total compensation package.
• Various team-building programs and company events.
• And many more! Apply and let us tell you more!

description:

Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.

You write clean, tested code, learn how banking-grade systems stay exact and auditable, and grow quickly toward owning features on your own.
• Build and maintain backend services and APIs for accounts, balances, transfers and payments, following the team's designs and standards
• Deliver well-scoped tasks from implementation to production, with unit and integration tests

• Data & Messaging: Working knowledge of transactions, and exposure to caching (Redis) and messaging (Kafka)
• Tools: Comfortable with Git, Docker and CI/CD, with exposure to a cloud platform (GCP or AWS)

• Hybrid Work Arrangement - Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and from the office
• Career Growth - Work closely with experienced leaders and take on meaningful ownership as we scale
• Employee Perks - Enjoy exclusive discounts, partnerships, and lifestyle perks

description:
Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Singapore, Group-IB is a leading creator of cybersecurity technologies to investigate, prevent, and fight digital crime. Combating cybercrime is in the company's DNA, shaping its unique accomplishments and expertise. The company is recognized by IDC, Gartner, and Forrester as a market leader in threat intelligence, digital risk protection, and fraud prevention. Group-IB's Unified Risk Platform is an ecosystem of solutions that understands each organization's threat profile and tailors defenses against them in real time, providing a complete and omnipresent immunity against all digital risks.
Group-IB's Digital Crime Resistance Centers (DCRCs) are located in the Middle East, Europe, Central Asia, and Asia-Pacific to help critically analyze and promptly mitigate regional and country-specific threats. These mission-critical units help Group-IB strengthen its contribution to global cybercrime prevention and continually expand its threat-hunting capabilities.
About The Role: You will be located in Jakarta, Indonesia and hunt in your territory, driving new business opportunities by being a spokesperson for Group-IB and evangelizing how Group-IB's products can help prospective customers solve critical business challenges in the most effective and innovative manner.
YOUR MISSION:
• Develop and manage accounts in your territory
• Identify, manage, and close multiple opportunities and projects at the same time, develop our commercial business in your territory
• Ensure accurate overview and forecasts of sales activities
• Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts
• Target, educate, and persuade new customers to use Group-IB products.
What We Are Looking For:
• 5+ years of closing/quota carrying experience in the software industry, preferably within security, extra points for threat intelligence, or an actor-centric cyber security company.
• BA/BS or equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Track record of success consistently exceeding overall goals in security technology sales.
• Entrepreneurial drive and ability to sell creative solutions into new markets.
• Confidence and track record building a new territory.
• Comfortable calling at the senior executive level.
• Highly effective written, presentation, and closing skills.
• Ability to travel extensively.
• Dynamic, high-energy self-starter.
• Experience with information security or threat intelligence is a plus.
WHY CHOOSE GROUP-IB: Group-IB is a global leader in cybersecurity technologies that investigate, predict, prevent, and fight digital crime. We help organizations reduce risk and protect trust. Trusted by governments, major industries, and law enforcement, we deliver adversary-focused, predictive threat intelligence and cyber fraud fusion solutions that detect, analyse, and mitigate regional and country-specific digital crimes.
• Work with real stakes. Group-IB investigates active cybercriminal groups, responds to breaches affecting critical infrastructure, and develops technologies used by law enforcement agencies including INTERPOL, Europol, and Afripol across 60+ countries. We've conducted 1,550+ cybercrime investigations alongside 600+ enterprise customers globally. When you join Group-IB, you work directly disrupts digital crime.
• Grow your way. Choose your own path: deepen your craft as a technical expert, step into leadership, move across to another team, or relocate to one of our Digital Crime Resistance Centers across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East & Africa, Central Asia, and the Asia-Pacific. Your growth is our growth — Group-IB's expansion across 60+ active country operations means real career acceleration.
• We fund professional certifications at company expense — whether you're pursuing CEH, CISSP, OSCP, or specialized certifications in forensics and penetration testing. You don't have to choose between doing the job and advancing your credentials.
• Work alongside industry leaders. Our Unified Risk Platform — Threat Intelligence, Digital Risk Protection, Attack Surface Management, Managed XDR, and more — is recognized by Gartner, Forrester, KuppingerCole, and Datos Insights. Frost & Sullivan named us a 2025 Global Technology Innovation Leader. When you work here, you're building technologies that set the industry standard.
• Real challenges, real expertise. You'll take on complex, real-world problems alongside adversary-centric researchers and incident response experts spread across six continents. We've built 21+ years of proprietary telemetry through 1,500+ joint investigations. No two threats look alike — and neither do the skills you'll develop.
• A team that is genuinely international. Our people come from different countries, speak different languages, and bring different perspectives. What connects us is a shared mission: fighting cybercrime and making the world safer. We care about your wellbeing and happiness as much as your output.

description:
Who We Are
Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 100+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 5,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects and works, and we need you to help us lead the way. We're seeking a curious, detail-oriented, and motivated Information Security Analyst to join our growing Information Security team and contribute to keeping Deel's platform, people, and customer data secure. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their security career to gain hands-on experience in a global, fast-paced, remote-first environment.

As an Information Security Analyst, you'll help safeguard our products and operations by supporting the implementation and maintenance of security controls, responding to security events, and contributing to compliance efforts, with the guidance and mentorship of experienced team members.

What you'll do
- Support the implementation and monitoring of security controls across our technology stack.
- Assist in responding to security alerts and incidents, including triage and documentation.
- Help maintain compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR) by contributing to evidence collection and internal reviews.
- Contribute to the development of security policies, standards, and procedures.
- Collaborate with Engineering, IT, Legal, and other teams on security reviews, risk assessments, and remediation tasks.
- Help maintain and improve security tools, configurations, and workflows.
- Support employee security awareness activities and training efforts.
- Participate in assessments of third-party vendors and tools.
- Learn and grow under the guidance of experienced security professionals.

What we're looking for
- 1–3 years of experience in information security, IT, or a related field, or relevant academic/technical training.
- Basic understanding of security principles and best practices, including authentication, access control, and network security.
- Familiarity with security frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or NIST is a plus.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
- Ability to learn new tools and technologies quickly.
- Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset.
- Curiosity and motivation to grow in the security field.

Bonus
- Exposure to cloud environments (AWS preferred) and SaaS products.
- Familiarity with security tools such as SIEM, endpoint detection, or vulnerability scanners.
- Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash).
- Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA Security+, ISC2 CC) are a plus, but not required.

Total Rewards
Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.

Some things you'll enjoy:
- Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location.
- Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country.
- The flexibility of remote work, including optional WeWork access.

For NYC Residents: In accordance with NYC Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on AEDT tools

We are hiring AI Red-Teaming Specialists to work on a project with a leading AI lab. In this role, you'll be part of a team responsible for identifying risks and vulnerabilities in frontier AI models — helping ensure they are safe, trustworthy, and aligned before deployment.

This is a remote, flexible position ideal for individuals who are passionate about AI safety, security, and responsible development.

- Interact with cutting-edge AI models through structured prompts and conversations to probe for harmful, biased, or unsafe behaviors

- Collaborate with AI safety researchers and engineers to refine evaluation methods
- Stay current with the latest AI safety research, red-teaming techniques, and responsible AI practices

Ideal Candidate
- Strong understanding of LLMs and how they work, including prompt engineering techniques
- Experience with AI red-teaming, adversarial testing, or AI safety research
- Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to document findings clearly
- Familiarity with common AI safety frameworks and evaluation methods
- Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a remote environment
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field preferred

Compensation
- Pay: $10/hr
- Contract Type: Short-Term Contract
- Commitment: 10-40 hrs/week (flexible scheduling)
- Location: 100% Remote

This is an incredible opportunity to work at the forefront of AI safety with a leading AI lab. If you're passionate about responsible AI and making models safer for everyone, we encourage you to apply!

description:
About the Company
Established in 2006, PT. INOSOFT TRANS SISTEM is a Surabaya-based software development company specializing in enterprise solutions for the logistics, supply chain, and asset management industries.
We build software that supports complex B2B operations—from inventory and logistics to asset movement and fleet management—used by major companies across Indonesia and the region.
Our solutions support important day-to-day business operations, where responsive customer support, clear communication, and quick problem-solving are essential.
At Inosoft, we believe in more than just technology—we believe in people. Our culture is built on integrity, growth, and collaboration, and we are looking for passionate individuals to join our team.
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced IT Customer Service Specialist to become a primary point of contact for our overseas customers. You will play a key role in ensuring a smooth and professional customer experience across our enterprise software products.
In this role, you will help customers with questions, concerns, service requests, and issues related to our products and services. You will work closely with our internal technical teams, including Project Managers, Developers, and QA Engineers, to ensure every customer issue is properly understood, followed up, and resolved.
A major part of this role is communication. You should be comfortable speaking and writing in English, as you will communicate daily with overseas customers.
You do not need to be a Developer or solve every technical issue yourself. However, you should be comfortable learning how enterprise software works, asking the right questions, performing basic initial checks, and escalating issues with complete and accurate information.
Your daily work will primarily involve customer communication through email and Microsoft Teams, managing support tickets in Jira, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely resolution.
Ideal for you if you're:
- A recent graduate or have experience in customer service
- Communicative, patient, and service-oriented
- Comfortable communicating in English (spoken and written)
- Willing to work a permanent night shift (8:00 PM - 5:00 AM WIB)
- Looking to grow a long-term career in customer service within a tech company
This is a full-time, fully remote position with a permanent night shift schedule from 8:00 PM to 5:00 AM WIB.
Key Responsibilities
- Communicate directly with overseas customers via email, Microsoft Teams, support portal, and online meetings.
- Respond professionally to customer inquiries, incidents, complaints, and service requests.
- Listen carefully, ask the right questions, and gather complete information to understand customer issues.
- Perform initial checks before escalating issues to Project Managers, Developers, or QA Engineers.
- Create, update, prioritize, and follow up customer support tickets in Jira.
- Monitor ticket progress and ensure customers receive clear and timely updates until resolution.
- Understand the urgency and business impact of customer issues and escalate critical issues appropriately.
- Communicate system-related information in a clear and customer-friendly manner.
- Maintain accurate support records and basic documentation in Jira and Confluence.
- Support Master Data Management (MDM) activities when required.
- Identify recurring customer issues and share improvement opportunities with internal teams.
- Continuously learn Inosoft's products, systems, and business processes.
Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree (S1) in any field. A degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field is a plus.
- 1-3 years of experience in customer service, customer support, or a similar role.
- Ability to learn new software systems quickly.
- Strong English communication skills, both spoken and written (TOEFL/IELTS certification is a plus, but not required).
- Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
- Patient, empathetic, and able to stay calm when handling difficult customers.
- Experience with Jira, Confluence, or CRM systems is a plus.
- Basic knowledge of enterprise software, ERP, or business operations (logistics, inventory, or asset management) is a plus.
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
- Comfortable collaborating with technical teams and comfortable working remotely.
- Willing to work a permanent night shift from 8:00 PM to 5:00 AM WIB.
- Willing to work full-time remotely.
JOIN US!
If you're passionate about helping customers succeed, solving software-related challenges, and working closely with technical teams to deliver outstanding enterprise customer support, we'd love to meet you
title: IT Customer Service Specialist

title: GTM Engineer (Singapore Time)
description:
Location: Fully Remote (Singapore time zone)

Start Date: ASAP

Languages: Fluent English required

Industry: AI / Data Infrastructure

Team: Go-to-Market (GTM)

Type: Full-time

About The Opportunity

Pragmatike is hiring a GTM Engineer on behalf of a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data.

Its marketplace connects data providers with leading AI companies, including startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier AI labs. Backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator, the company is scaling rapidly and expanding its commercial operations.

The company operates a two-sided marketplace where leading AI labs specify the data they need, and the commercial team identifies businesses and individuals who can provide it. As the business grows, the focus is shifting towards building the systems and infrastructure needed to scale these operations efficiently.

As a GTM Engineer, you'll approach go-to-market as an engineering challenge. You'll own the technical infrastructure behind the commercial team, building data pipelines, automations, integrations and internal tools that help a lean team source, qualify and close opportunities at scale.

This is an engineering-first role with a strong commercial focus, ideal for someone who enjoys building practical systems, solving operational bottlenecks and working closely with sales teams and founders.

The company has offices in San Francisco and Singapore, with remote opportunities also available. Working hours will align with either Singapore or US Pacific business hours, depending on your location.

What You'll Do

Own the GTM tooling stack end to end, including selecting, configuring, integrating and maintaining the tools used by the commercial team.
Build scalable sourcing systems, including scrapers and data enrichment pipelines, to identify relevant data providers and opportunities.
Develop and maintain the data infrastructure behind GTM, connecting CRM, marketplace and product data into a reliable source of truth for pipeline, listings and revenue.
Build internal tools to support provider research, listing quality checks, pipeline management and sales forecasting.
Automate repetitive workflows across sourcing, qualification, lead routing and reporting.
Identify operational bottlenecks with the founders and commercial team, prioritising automation projects with the highest impact.
Explore and implement AI agents where they provide clear advantages over traditional automation.
Make build-versus-buy decisions for GTM tooling, keeping the technical stack efficient, reliable and easy to maintain.

What We're Looking For

2+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Strong programming skills in Python or TypeScript, with fluent SQL.
Experience building internal tools, automations or integrations used by other teams in their day-to-day operations.
Hands-on experience developing data pipelines and API integrations between different business systems.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
Commercial awareness and an interest in revenue operations, with the ability to understand sales workflows and prioritise projects that directly support business growth.
Clear written communication skills and the ability to take ownership in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

Nice to Have:

Experience in RevOps, growth engineering, sales engineering or forward-deployed engineering.
Hands-on experience implementing LLMs or AI agents in production environments.
Previous experience in an early-stage startup or as a founder.
Familiarity with AI training data, including RL environments, evaluations and benchmarks.

We're open to motivated candidates who don't meet every requirement. Strong engineering fundamentals, ownership and the ability to learn quickly are what matter most.

Why This Opportunity

Build systems that drive revenue: Develop the tools, integrations and pipelines that power the entire commercial operation.
High impact in a lean team: Automate critical workflows and help a small GTM team operate at significantly greater scale.
Work directly with founders: Collaborate closely with the founding and commercial teams, identifying problems and deciding what is worth building.
Work with modern AI tooling: Explore and implement AI agents and automation solutions where they deliver real operational value.
Flexible working setup: Choose between on-site opportunities in San Francisco or Singapore, or remote work aligned with Singapore or US Pacific business hours.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

Pragmatike is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants without discrimination. We recruit on behalf of our clients and prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

We are committed to a fair and inclusive hiring process. We process your personal data solely for recruitment purposes, in accordance with applicable privacy laws, and maintain reasonable safeguards to protect your information. Your data may be shared with our client(s) for hiring consideration, but will not be disclosed to third parties outside of the recruitment process.

title: Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization (Singapore Time)
description:
Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones)

Start Date: ASAP

Languages: English

Team: Engineering

About The Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines — protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation. This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70–80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

• Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.
• Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.
• Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.
• Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.
• Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.
• Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

• Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.
• Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.
• Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.
• An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data — and when each is appropriate.
• High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.
• Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.
• Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.
• Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.
• Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

• Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.
• Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.
• From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.
• Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.
• San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70–80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

Pragmatike is an Equal Opportunity Employer...

WasteX provides a globally-unique, full-stack biochar solution for agricultural producers and carbon projects developers in Indonesia, India and elsewhere internationally. We help our clients utilize biomass waste, improve productivity, and generate additional income while removing carbon. We also operate biochar production facilities in Indonesia producing and selling biochar, and generating and selling carbon credits.
We are a VC-backed climate tech startup headquartered in Singapore with operations in Indonesia and India.
Role
We are looking for a Biochar B2B Commercialization Manager to build and lead our biochar sales across Indonesia and into export markets. You will own the full commercial cycle: identifying target segments and accounts, developing applications with clients, negotiating offtake agreements, and turning trials into recurring volume.
We want a commercial professional who thinks strategically and executes hands-on. You should be comfortable selling a new product category to agribusinesses, industrial buyers and international distributors and buyers alike.
We are at an early stage, so you will have a real chance to shape how biochar is positioned and priced in Indonesia, build the company's commercial engine from the ground up, and drive measurable climate impact.
Responsibilities
Agriculture
Drive biochar sales to plantations (palm oil and others), agri producers, and fertilizer and organic fertilizer manufacturers
Develop and manage field trials and demo plots with clients, and translate results into commercial agreements
Industrial applications
Open and develop new markets for biochar in cement and construction, water filtration, steel, mining and other industrial uses
Work with the technical and production teams to match biochar specifications to each application's requirements
Export
Develop export sales to Japan, Australia and other international markets, working with importers, distributors and buyers
Across all segments
Build and manage a qualified sales pipeline, with clear forecasts and reporting to management
Set pricing, prepare commercial proposals and negotiate offtake and supply contracts
Coordinate with production on volumes, quality and delivery schedules
Gather market and competitor intelligence to inform product development and commercial strategy
Represent WasteX at industry events, trade shows and client meetings
Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in business, agriculture, chemical or environmental engineering, or a related field
- 5-10 years of B2B sales / business development experience, ideally in fertilizers, agri-inputs, activated carbon, industrial minerals, chemicals or similar materials
- Proven track record of closing and growing large B2B accounts in Indonesia
- An existing network among plantations, fertilizer manufacturers or industrial buyers is a strong plus
- Export sales experience, particularly to Japan or Australia, is a strong plus
- Ability to understand and explain technical product properties to non-technical and technical buyers
- Strong negotiation, communication and relationship-building skills
- Fluency in Bahasa Indonesia and English
- Self-driven and comfortable working independently in an early-stage company
Offer
- Competitive salary plus performance-based incentives
- Opportunity to build a new market category from the ground up, with a high-impact product, while mitigating climate change
- Opportunity to work in a high-energy, high-performance organization

We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented and proactive Interior Designer who enjoys designing, solving problems, communicating with people and taking ownership of their work.
At Loren Ng Designs, we believe good design goes beyond aesthetics and drawings. It's about understanding people, how they live, and how they experience their spaces.
We want someone who shares this thinking and takes pride in creating thoughtful spaces and enjoyable client experiences, from the first design discussion to post-project aftercare.
What You'll Be Doing
1. Interior Design & Development

- Translate clients' requirements, preferences and lifestyles into practical and thoughtful design solutions.
- Research materials, products, finishes and creative design possibilities.
- Prepare accurate design drawings, presentations and proposals.
- Incorporate client feedback and coordinate design revisions.
- Ensure all design deliverables meet quality standards and deadlines.
2. Sales & Client Support
- Support the Director and Operations Manager in sales activities and client presentations.
- Provide design insights and recommendations during client discussions.
- Assist in preparing quotations, design proposals and presentation materials.
- Research suitable products and solutions based on clients' needs.
- Coordinate with suppliers to obtain pricing, specifications, samples and product information.
3. Supplier & Site Coordination
- Communicate and coordinate with suppliers, vendors, contractors and site teams.
- Follow up on quotations, product enquiries, procurement requests and outstanding matters.
- Provide technical clarification and ensure design details are accurately communicated to the site team.
- Proactively resolve issues or escalate matters when necessary.
- Take ownership of assigned tasks until they are completed.
4. Client Experience & Aftercare
- Think beyond project completion and consider the overall client experience throughout their journey with LND.
- Research and understand customer feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
- Support client follow-ups and post-project aftercare coordination.
- Identify recurring client concerns and share suggestions with the team.
- Think creatively about how we can make the entire client journey more thoughtful, enjoyable and memorable.
5. Communication & Ownership
- Maintain clear, timely and proactive communication with the internal team and external parties.
- Follow up on pending matters without waiting for reminders.
- Keep the team updated on progress, outstanding tasks and potential delays.
- Manage multiple priorities independently and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
- Take responsibility for assigned work from start to finish.
What We're Looking For
- Diploma or degree in Interior Design or a related field.
- Proficient in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator and Canva.
- Good understanding of space planning, materials, finishes and construction details.
- Creative, curious and willing to explore new ideas.
- Good communication and coordination skills, especially in a remote working environment.
- Comfortable communicating with suppliers, contractors and site teams.
- Proactive, organised and strong in follow-through.
- Able to manage multiple priorities and solve problems independently.
- Good attention to detail and a genuine interest in understanding people, their lifestyles and their experiences.
What Success Looks Like
- You produce thoughtful, practical and quality design work.
- You communicate proactively and keep everyone informed.
- You take ownership and follow through without constant reminders.
- You understand that a successful project is not just about delivering good design, but also creating a positive client experience.
Important: Remote Working Position
This is a remote position that requires a high level of independence, communication and accountability.
You are expected to manage your own time, stay responsive during agreed working hours, meet deadlines and take initiative without waiting for instructions at every step.
If you enjoy designing, working with people, solving problems and taking ownership of your work, we'd love to hear from you.

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized apps (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and empower our employees to build a better future for everyone.

We're currently seeking a Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) to join our Indonesia team. This role is critical in ensuring OKX Indonesia's compliance with all applicable Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorism Financing (CTF) laws and regulations, maintaining robust systems and controls, and fostering a culture of integrity and accountability within the organization.

What You'll Be Doing

- Oversee the monitoring and reporting of suspicious transactions, ensuring timely filing of reports to PPATK and other relevant bodies.
- Conduct risk assessments and ensure the company's AML/CTF framework is aligned with the risk profile of the business and customers.
- Lead and manage the AML compliance team, providing guidance and training to staff on AML/CTF obligations.
- Oversee customer due diligence (CDD), enhanced due diligence (EDD), and ongoing monitoring processes.
- Ensure compliance with sanctions screening and other regulatory requirements.

- Stay current on regulatory developments and proactively adapt the company's compliance framework.

- Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field. A master's degree or relevant certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) is preferred.
- Minimum 5-7 years of experience in AML/CTF compliance, preferably within the financial services or crypto industry in Indonesia.
- Proven track record as an MLRO or in a senior AML compliance role, with in-depth knowledge of Indonesian AML regulations and international standards (FATF).
- Strong understanding of crypto assets, blockchain technology, and the risks associated with digital asset transactions.

title: Associate Manager FinCrime
description:
About The Company

Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!

We’re building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building.

Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment.

Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.

About The Team

Aspire’s FinCrime team protects the platform and its customers from money laundering, fraud and other financial crime. Working closely with Compliance, KYC, Payments and Transaction Monitoring, the team builds and runs the controls that keep Aspire compliant and safe as we scale across Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia, the EU and now the US. You’ll sit within the FinCrime Ops team, reporting to the Global Head of FinCrime Operations, and act as the FinCrime Senior Analyst for our US business.

About The Role

We’re hiring a FinCrime Operations Senior Analyst to support Aspire’s US expansion. This is a hands-on ops role covering both Fraud and AML: you’ll investigate cases, file SARs, handle US-specific payment fraud and AML typologies and help shape the controls that protect our US customers. You’ll bring a working understanding of how US businesses are formed and operate, how they move money, and how criminals exploit each of those, and you’ll turn that knowledge into playbooks the wider team can run.

Investigate AML, Fraud and Scam cases for US customers end to end, from alert or referral through to decision, offboarding where needed, and documentation
Draft and file SARs in line with FinCEN requirements and timelines, and maintain audit-ready case records
Identify and act on US-relevant typologies: business email compromise and payment redirection, account takeover, ACH debit fraud and return abuse, wire fraud, money mule and funnel accounts, synthetic and shell business onboarding, check fraud, investment and romance scam proceeds, sanctions evasion and trade-based laundering
Assess US businesses at onboarding and through their lifecycle: entity type (LLC, C-corp, S-corp, sole proprietorship), state of formation, Secretary of State records, EIN, registered agent and virtual office use, beneficial ownership and foreign-owned US entities
Run US payment-specific processes, including ACH unauthorized returns and NACHA timelines, wire recall and beneficiary bank outreach, and OFAC screening alerts
Handle law enforcement requests, subpoenas and 314(a)/(b) information sharing in coordination with Compliance
Act as day-to-day FinCrime liaison with Aspire’s US partner bank(s) on cases, escalations and reporting
Partner with Compliance, Onboarding and Engineering to adapt rules, onboarding checks and monitoring scenarios for US rails and customer segments
Build and maintain US SOPs, typology guides and red-flag training for onboarding, CX and ops teams
Track fraud losses, case volumes, alert quality and SAR metrics, and report trends to senior stakeholders

Minimum Qualifications

5+ years in AML, fraud/scam typologies, with at least 3 years handling US-market cases at a fintech, neobank, BaaS program or bank
Practical experience across both fraud and AML investigations, including drafting and filing SARs
Strong understanding of US fraud and AML typologies affecting business accounts and payments
Solid working knowledge of how US businesses are registered and operate, including entity types, state filings, EINs, registered agents and beneficial ownership, and the red flags that separate real businesses from shells
Good understanding of US money movement: ACH (including NACHA rules and return codes), domestic and international wires, and business card programs, and how fraud and liability work on each
Familiarity with the US regulatory framework for financial crime: BSA/AML, FinCEN SAR obligations, OFAC sanctions, and how sponsor bank oversight shapes fintech programs
Understanding of the kinds of businesses Aspire serves in the US, such as venture-backed startups, e-commerce sellers, SaaS companies, agencies, import/export businesses and foreign-founded US entities, and their typical risk profiles
Strong grasp of AI concepts and the ability to apply AI tools (e.g., Claude, n8n) to real workflows

Preferred Qualifications

Experience at a US sponsor bank or within a BaaS program, including exams or partner bank audits
A self started with experience building or scaling a US FinCrime ops function at an early-stage or high-growth company
Exposure to RTP/FedNow, stablecoins or crypto on/off ramps, and cross-border FX
Hands-on use of tools such as Sardine, Alloy, Unit21, Middesk, Socure or LexisNexis
Basic SQL or data-querying skills (e.g., Databricks)
CAMS, CFE or equivalent certification

Location: Fully Remote

Employment Type: Full-time

Schedule: Monday–Friday, rotating shifts

Experience: 1–3 years

About the Role

We’re looking for a Service Delivery Representative to support global customers across multiple time zones.

You’ll own customer requests from intake to resolution or handover, coordinate with internal teams, track SLAs, and ensure customers receive timely updates.

This is a customer-facing operations role for someone who is highly organised, proactive, and confident communicating in English.

What You’ll Do

Own and manage customer requests across email, ticketing platforms, Slack, and other channels.
Keep customers updated on progress, delays, and next steps.
Monitor tickets, SLAs, deadlines, and outstanding actions.
Coordinate with IT, Supply Chain, Finance, and Customer Success teams.
Follow up with internal teams and vendors to keep requests moving.
Handle basic L1 issues using SOPs and knowledge bases.
Maintain accurate records and clear handover notes.
Identify recurring issues and suggest process improvements.

What We’re Looking For

1–3 years of experience in customer service, service delivery, IT support coordination, operations, or a similar role.
Excellent written and verbal English.
Strong organisation, attention to detail, and multitasking skills.
Strong ownership and follow-through.
Customer-first and solutions-oriented mindset.
Comfortable coordinating across teams and escalating issues when needed.
Willing to work rotating Monday–Friday shifts, changing every 4–8 weeks.

Nice to Have

Experience with Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira, or similar platforms.
Basic ITIL / IT service management knowledge.
Experience in IT operations, logistics, procurement, shipping, or vendor coordination.

title: KAM - Associate Partner
description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity

Are you ready to take your sales career to the next level by leading one of FICO’s most critical client accounts? This role is your chance to lead a cornerstone account for a global leader in analytics and decisioning technology. You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of a premier client’s business while achieving significant personal and professional growth. With over 60 years of consistent growth, FICO’s world-class solutions empower thousands of businesses worldwide to make smarter fraud, risk, and customer management decisions. As a senior member of our Sales organization, you will leverage your deep expertise, strategic acumen, and consultative-selling prowess to strengthen and expand a marquee client relationship. This is not just another sales role—it’s an opportunity to make a significant impact by partnering with a global financial institution to address their most urgent challenges with FICO’s advanced technologies. If you’re a results-driven, senior-level professional with a passion for delivering innovative solutions and driving exceptional outcomes, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Contribute

Strategic Leadership: Build and nurture relationships with C-suite and senior client stakeholders to uncover and address their most critical business challenges, demonstrating the value of FICO’s solutions at every turn.
Solution Innovation: Collaborate with internal teams across sales, product, delivery, and marketing to design tailored, enterprise-grade solutions that align with client needs and long-term strategies.
Complex Deal Structuring: Lead high-stakes negotiations for multi-million-dollar contracts, ensuring mutually beneficial outcomes that protect and expand FICO’s footprint within the account.
Client Advocacy: Serve as the voice of the client within FICO, influencing product roadmaps and solution strategies to address evolving market demands.
Business Growth: Develop and execute comprehensive business plans that drive account expansion and long-term profitability, while achieving quarterly and annual sales targets with significant upside potential.
Market Leadership: Represent FICO as a trusted advisor, staying ahead of industry trends and positioning the company as the go-to partner for advanced analytics and decisioning solutions.

What We’re Seeking

Proven Senior-Level Experience: Demonstrated success in building and managing strategic relationships with senior executives, particularly within large financial institutions.
Enterprise Solution Sales Expertise: A track record of structuring and closing complex, multi-million-dollar deals, including SaaS-based solutions that expand existing offerings or integrate into larger solution bundles.
Industry Knowledge: Deep familiarity with banking, credit risk, fraud prevention, account management, or consumer lending. Experience in applying technologies such as machine learning, AI, decision management, and optimization is highly desirable.
Strategic Vision and Execution: Ability to craft and execute joint business plans that align with client objectives and FICO’s strategic priorities.
Growth Mindset: A Passion to learn and educate customers and FICO colleagues through presentations, and conversations. Strong soft skills, and a genuine interest in people and a desire to help them be wildly successful.
Resiliency: Able to maintain focus and effectiveness under pressure, adaptable to change, and recover quickly from setbacks.
Collaborative Leadership: A team-oriented mindset that values collaboration and leverages the collective strengths of colleagues to deliver exceptional results.
Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel up to 50% to maintain a close partnership with the client and foster meaningful, face-to-face interactions.
Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent commercial experience.

Our Offer to You

An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers

FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.

title: AI & Data Architect
description:
Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PCMag, WRS Health delivers fully integrated, cloud-based EMR and practice management solutions. We support physicians through continuous enhancements to our products and services, including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination, and billing.

Job Purpose and Role

We are seeking a highly skilled AI/Data Architect to design and manage the data infrastructure that supports reporting, advanced analytics, and AI applications across WRS Health. This role will work closely with AI Engineers, developers, and business stakeholders to make healthcare data accessible, reliable, secure, and ready for use in machine learning and large language model (LLM) applications.

Key Responsibilities

Design and maintain scalable data architectures and pipelines that support reporting, analytics, and AI applications.
Define data models, storage strategies, and integration patterns for structured and unstructured healthcare data.
Build and maintain pipelines to collect, clean, transform, and validate data from clinical, financial, operational, and marketing systems.
Partner with AI Engineers to define data requirements and prepare datasets for model development, fine-tuning, and evaluation.
Design the data foundation for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), including document processing, embeddings, vector storage, and retrieval.
Establish shared data interfaces and APIs that enable AI Engineers to integrate LLM capabilities into EHR applications.
Manage data storage and retrieval for patient records, IoT, genomic, microbiome, and government datasets.
Support healthcare interoperability using FHIR, HL7, JSON, XML, C-CDA, NCPDP, and X12 standards.
Design and manage AWS data and analytics infrastructure supporting QuickSight, SageMaker, Bedrock, and Amazon Q.
Develop reports and dashboards that provide actionable insights across departments.
Establish data quality checks, lineage, versioning, and documentation so datasets and AI outputs can be traced to their sources.
Implement access controls and appropriate handling of sensitive healthcare data across analytics and AI workflows.
Collaborate with AI Engineers on MLOps and LLMOps requirements, including reproducible data pipelines, monitoring, and deployment integration.
Monitor and improve infrastructure reliability, retrieval performance, processing speed, and operating costs.
Translate stakeholder needs into technical specifications and maintain architecture documentation.

Qualifications

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
Proven experience in data architecture and engineering, including infrastructure supporting AI or machine learning applications.
Strong expertise in data modeling, database design, and scalable data processing.
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience building data pipelines and API integrations.
Experience designing solutions using relational databases, data warehouses or data lakes, and vector databases.
Hands-on experience with data preparation for LLM applications, including document processing, chunking, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation.
Understanding of how data quality, retrieval design, and source context affect LLM response accuracy and relevance.
Experience with AWS data and AI services, including familiarity with QuickSight, SageMaker, Bedrock, and Amazon Q.
Familiarity with MLOps and LLMOps practices, including dataset versioning, evaluation datasets, and production monitoring.
Working knowledge of LLM APIs and frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex to collaborate effectively with AI Engineers.
Understanding of data governance, privacy, security, and access controls for sensitive healthcare information.
Experience with FHIR, HL7, JSON, XML, X12, and healthcare data exchange is highly preferred.
Experience with visualization tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, or Power BI.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Healthcare industry experience and familiarity with HubSpot are a plus.

A Day in the Life

You’ll review pipeline health and data quality, collaborate with AI Engineers to prepare datasets and improve data retrieval, and build data models, integrations, and dashboards. Throughout the day, you’ll work with stakeholders to resolve data issues and ensure the infrastructure supports reporting and AI application needs.

Success Metrics

Pipeline reliability, data freshness, and data quality meet agreed targets.
AI Engineers receive validated, traceable datasets within agreed timelines.
Retrieval accuracy, response times, and infrastructure costs meet project targets.
Reporting and data automation reduce manual work and support stakeholder adoption.

If you are passionate about building the data foundation for practical healthcare AI solutions, we encourage you to apply.

Job Summary: Our client, a fast-growing SaaS company building AI-powered lending software, is looking for a hands-on, curious Junior AI / Agentic Systems Developer to build and test AI agent workflows and support customer onboarding and migration. Working directly with the CTO, you will design autonomous and human-in-the-loop agents that automate core lending operations, including loan applications, KYC verification, credit checking, collections, and loan disbursement. You will rapidly build pilots, measure their accuracy and safety, and help move successful workflows into production.

Job Description — AI Agent Development & Integration:
- Design, prototype, and iterate on multi-step AI agent workflows for loan applications, document verification, credit risk checks, collections, and disbursement triggers.
- Connect AI agents securely to Python (FastAPI) backend systems, PostgreSQL databases, and third-party APIs using tool calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Contribute features to backend systems and React/TypeScript web applications, including automated testing.
- Package agent services using Docker and deploy them on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), implementing logging, tracing, and guardrails.
- Build deterministic checks and human-in-the-loop approval steps to prevent inaccurate financial decisions and unauthorized disbursements.

Customer Onboarding & Migration:
- Migrate customer data from legacy systems using repeatable import scripts, ensuring record and balance accuracy.
- Configure customer users, settings, and workflows, and support go-live activities.
- Train customer staff remotely or on-site, prepare user guides, and provide initial support.

Job Requirements — Core Backend & Cloud (Must-Have):
- Solid proficiency in Python and experience building REST APIs with FastAPI (or Flask/Django).
- Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills; database migration experience is a strong plus.
- Hands-on familiarity with Docker, Linux, and GCP services such as Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Secret Manager, and IAM.
- Practical experience building with Anthropic Claude using the Anthropic Python SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or Claude on Google Cloud Vertex AI, including structured outputs and tool/function use.

Agentic & Workflow Engineering (Strong Plus / Willingness to Learn Fast):
- Experience with LangGraph, Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), or custom Python state machines and job queues.
- Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), prompt engineering, and evaluation techniques.
- Working knowledge of React and TypeScript.
- Familiarity with Git, Docker Compose, and automated testing (pytest).

Mindset & Background:
- 2+ years of software engineering experience. Fresh graduates with strong personal or hackathon AI agent projects are encouraged to apply.
- Strong sense of ownership, security, data privacy, and financial accuracy.
- Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
- Based in Jakarta, Indonesia.
- Strong Bahasa Indonesia communication skills and working proficiency in English.
- Willingness to travel occasionally for customer onboarding.

Additional Information:
- Location: Jakarta Region, Indonesia (Hybrid / Work from Home)
- Employment Type: Full-Time
- Reports To: CTO
- Travel: Occasional, company-paid
- Direct collaboration with the CTO on strategic projects.
- Opportunity to develop AI prototypes into production systems.
- Access to Anthropic models and GCP infrastructure for experimentation and development.

Contact: apply online or send CV to Talent@mcs-global.com, or WhatsApp https://wa.me/6282137682541

About the Role

As our Technical Writer, you own project documentation from kickoff to handover. You’ll sit in requirement-gathering sessions with business process owners, turn those discussions into clear, structured documents, and keep those documents accurate as the project changes. You’ll work closely with the PM, Business Analyst, engineers and designers. You don’t need to write code, but you do need to understand how a system works well enough to document it correctly.

Responsibilities

Meetings: Write formal Minutes of Meeting (MOM) for client sessions, recording questions, answers, confirmed business rules and action items for each module. Keep open-item and follow-up trackers up to date
Initiation: Prepare the Project Charter, project schedule narrative and supporting sections of technical proposals
Requirements: Write and maintain the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and Functional Specification Document (FSD), including process flows, business rules, user roles and acceptance criteria
Technical: Support engineers on the Technical Specification Document (TSD), covering architecture, database design, API endpoints and integration flows
Testing: Prepare test scenarios and test cases for Unit Testing (UT), System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Document test results and UAT sign-off records
Delivery & handover: Write user manuals, release notes, deployment checklists and handover documents (BAST)
Quality: Apply consistent templates, version control, document history and approval tables across all deliverables

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Communications or a related field
2+ years as a Technical Writer, Business Analyst, System Analyst or Project Documentation Officer on software/IT projects
Excellent formal Bahasa Indonesia writing (business and government style) and good written English
Hands-on experience with at least some of: BRD, FSD, TSD, MOM, test scenarios, UAT documents, user manuals
Understands core technical concepts: databases and tables, APIs, system flows, user roles and permissions. Can read an ERD or flowchart and ask good follow-up questions.
Can listen to a long multi-stakeholder meeting and pull out what was decided, what’s still open and who owns each item
Strong with Microsoft Word and Excel or Google Workspace (styles, tables, table of contents, tracked changes).
Detail-oriented, organised and comfortable managing several documents across projects at once

Nice to Have

Experience on enterprise, BUMN or government projects (procurement, energy, logistics or finance)
Can draw process flows (BPMN, swimlanes), Visio, Figma or similar
Uses AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc) to speed up drafting and transcription, and knows how to verify the output
Familiar with SDLC/Agile, and tools like ClickUp, Jira or Confluence

description: Reimagine access. Reimagine ownership. Build the future with Cinch. Cinch is Southeast Asia's leading circular tech subscription company, redefining how people and businesses access technology. Instead of adding to the growing e-waste crisis, we enable affordable, sustainable access to devices through subscriptions that maximize reuse and extend their lifecycle. We operate across B2C, B2B, and B2B2C channels, including major partnerships with global leaders like Samsung. Our model sits at the intersection of powerful mega trends—sustainability, embedded finance, and the shift from ownership to access—creating a massive opportunity to reshape the future of tech consumption. At Cinch, we are builders with high standards, a bias for action, and a shared mission to create a generational company that outlasts us. Freshly funded by leading institutional investors and growing rapidly, we're creating an environment where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers—and where the work has real, lasting impact. The Role We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to build the credit models that decide who Cinch lends to, on what terms, and how we collect. Every subscription at Cinch is a customer relationship and a credit exposure on a physical device, so your models directly shape growth, losses and asset returns. You will own credit and risk models end to end: from data exploration and feature design through validation, deployment and monitoring. You will work with SQL and Python, partner with Data, Product and Engineering teams, and turn model outputs into decisions the business can act on. You are expected to be AI-literate and comfortable working with Claude. We expect responsible AI use, and the correctness of all work submitted remains the author's own responsibility. Responsibilities Risk and credit modelling • Build, validate and maintain credit scoring models for new and repeat subscribers - A Score and B Score models. • Develop early-warning and delinquency models, and support collections strategy and prioritisation • Run experiments and champion/challenger tests to prove a model improves approval rates, losses or recovery before it scales • Track model performance over time (stability, drift, bias) and retrain when it degrades Data and features • Collect and blend data from multiple sources (applications, payments, devices, bureau and alternative data) into clean, documented feature sets • Work with data analysts and engineers on dimensional models and data pipelines so features stay consistent between training and production • Define and track the risk KPIs the business relies on (approval rate, default rate, loss per cohort, recovery rate) Decisioning and partnership • Turn model outputs into clear decision rules and recommendations to guide credit policy at Cinch. • Present findings and trade-offs to leadership in plain language, including what the model cannot tell us • Partner with Risk & Data leadership on credit policy and regulatory expectations in each market Standards, AI and mentoring • Document models so another data scientist can reproduce and audit them • Use AI tools (Claude Desktop, Claude Code) to speed up exploration, coding and documentation, and set the standard for responsible use with sensitive customer data Qualifications Must-have • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science or a related field (or equivalent experience) • 6-9 years of experience in data science or advanced analytics, including building models that went into production • Strong SQL and Python (including familiarity with all the relevant frameworks and packages such as pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost or similar) for data manipulation and modelling • Solid grounding in statistics and machine learning for classification and risk: logistic regression, gradient boosting, calibration, cross-validation, and evaluation metrics such as AUC, KS and Gini • Experience with model validation, monitoring and documentation, and explaining model results to non-technical stakeholders • Working knowledge of dimensional modelling and data pipelines, and the ability to work with analysts and engineers on feature data • Working proficiency with AI tools Nice-to-haves • Experience in fintech, lending, consumer credit, e-commerce or subscription businesses • Credit scorecard development, collections analytics or fraud detection • Experience with cloud data warehouses and modern data stack tools (for example BigQuery, dbt, SQLMesh) • Experience with BI tools such as Apache Superset or Looker • Experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n, and with deploying models to production • Familiarity with regulatory expectations for credit data and model use in Malaysia or other Southeast Asian markets
