title: 1:1 Mentorship Program Lead
description: About Indigo Indigo Research is dedicated to transforming the education landscape by pairing high school students with research mentors to complete and publish research projects. Whether in-person or online, we aim to deliver transformative educational experiences and cultivate the next generation of scholars. Role Overview The 1:1 Program Lead is a key member of the Operations Team responsible for the end-to-end planning, execution, and student success across our 1:1 Online Research Mentorship programs (Explorer, Researcher, and Innovator). Operating in a 100% virtual environment, the PL manages bespoke, long-term student journeys ranging from 12 weeks to 50+ weeks. This role focuses on mentor matching, tracking multi-milestone research deliverables, maintaining parent/family communications, facilitating academic credits, and supporting publication/competition submissions. The 1:1 PL must be highly organized, proactive, and comfortable working across different stakeholders and in ambiguous, fast-paced environments. They will directly oversee Operations staff, ensuring that team KPIs are met and that students continue to succeed as Indigo expands. Key Responsibilities Team Leadership & Operations Oversight • Oversee Mentor Operations Lead, supervising the execution of the end-to-end Mentor Lifecycle. Ensure accountability for mentor KPI tracking systems, mentor performance reviews, recertification efforts (IRB & Publication Support), capacity forecasting, and reduction of mentor-related escalations. • Oversee Junior Operations Coordinator, providing direction on mentor allocations, ensuring target turnarounds, administrative support SOPs, database accuracy, and student progress follow-ups. • Align mentor management systems and allocation pipelines with 1:1 program outcomes to eliminate bottlenecks and operational friction for workflow optimization. Project & Student Journey Management • Ensure a stellar program experience across all three 1:1 tiers (Explorer: 10 hrs / 12 wks; Researcher: 20 hrs / 23 wks; Innovator: 45 hrs / 50 wks). • Implement a 5-star outcome plan, increasing student success rates and achieving higher levels of student outcomes while maintaining current student outcome rates. • Act as the primary escalation contact to handle and resolve student, family, or mentor conflicts, maintaining high satisfaction and delivering practical solutions. • Oversee escalation ops, including devising systems to support tracking, analyzing performance, interventions, and ways to lower or eliminate escalations entirely. Mentor & Stakeholder Management • Review mentor KPIs and PRs to discuss performance, share best practices, and drive continuous improvement. • Provide operational support, guidelines, and Checkpoint System tracking. • Identify scalable systems for improved mentor management, eliminating manual operations and giving mentors more high-touch opportunities for feedback and support. • Work with Indigo staff to convene Academic and Scientific Review Committees, identifying areas of improvement and achieving progress against priorities (e.g. AI policies, academic integrity). Operations & Continuous Improvement • Work with Operations Lead to monitor student progress via tracking dashboards, coordinating with Student Success and Indigo Ops teams to strategically intervene as needed. • Implement a new escalation prediction system, monitoring hotspots and eliminating escalations and other challenges before they occur. • With the Indigo SSM, analyze operational data and Net Promoter Scores (NPS) to identify service gaps and implement scalable, automated workflows. • Maintain seamless integration with Student Success Teams and Crimson Education stakeholders. Qualifications Qualifications & Skills • Experience: 3–5 years of experience in education, mentoring, academic coaching, or youth development organizations. • People Management: At least 2 years of experience directly overseeing teams. • Education & Research Knowledge: Familiarity with high school research, academic writing, citation standards, and the journal publication process. • System Knowledge: Knowledge of international education systems and US/UK college admissions (e.g., Common App, STEM supplements). • Technical Skills: Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office Suite, and learning systems/CRM tools Skills & Competencies • People Management: Ability to mentor, guide, and hold operational staff (Mentor Ops Lead, Jr. Ops Coordinator) accountable to performance metrics. • Project Management: Highly organized with exceptional ability to manage asynchronous workflows across diverse time zones. • Customer Service & Communication: Advanced English proficiency with a high-empathy, client-centric mindset for interacting with high-achieving students and families. • Problem-Solving & De-escalation: Grace under pressure, adept at resolving cross-cultural and communication challenges. • Analytical Thinking: Capability to identify needed KPIs and track track them, spot engagement drop-offs, and execute timely interventions. What Success Looks Like • Team Leadership & Operations Performance • Mentor Ops Lead Accountability: Successful rollout of mentor training programs and policies, maintaining active mentor performance/KPI tracking and ensuring they are met. • Jr. Ops Coordinator Efficiency: Mentor–student allocation turnaround time consistently maintained at ≤2 business days with zero allocation bottlenecks or talent shortages. • Team Synergy: Smooth operational execution across the team with clear SOP adoption, minimal administrative backlogs, and accurate database records. • Student Outcomes & Program Delivery • 5-Star Outcome Delivery: Successful execution of the 5-star outcome plan, increasing advanced student outcomes (e.g., publication, conference presentation, ISEF progress) while maintaining overall program completion rates. • Milestone Progress Tracking: High completion rates of target deliverables within projected program timelines. • Escalation Management & Retention Escalation Reduction & Elimination: Lower overall monthly student/parent/mentor escalations to <0.5% of active students through early warning tracking systems and proactive interventions. • De-escalation Speed & Resolution: Rapid resolution of escalations with structured follow-ups, maintaining high family and mentor trust. • Scalability & Operational Excellence • System Automation & Efficiency: Creating scalable, automated workflows with the Operations team to reduce manual intervention and streamline cross-team communications with Crimson & Student Success Teams. • Data-Driven Improvements: Utilizing performance dashboards and KPI analytics to systematically identify and resolve service gaps before they impact student experience.

act when performance falls short • Resolve channel overlap with commercial leadership per agreed pricing, ownership and approval rules • Bring structured customer and partner feedback into product positioning, packaging and go-to-market decisions What We're Looking For • 4+ years of B2B sales, channel development or partner management experience, with evidence of recruiting partners and generating revenue through them • Experience selling enterprise software, SaaS, data platforms, supply chain solutions, sustainability technology or comparable business solutions • Ability to build a partner network from the ground up and personally help partners progress and close customer opportunities • Strong commercial judgement, consultative selling, presentation, negotiation and relationship management skills • A disciplined approach to pipeline management, forecasting and follow-up • Confidence working independently in an evolving business, coordinating across teams and owning results • Professional English communication skills — additional languages are a plus depending on the assigned market • Willingness to travel for partner development, training and customer meetings Helpful Experience • An established network of relevant resellers, systems integrators, consultants, associations or enterprise customers • Exposure to product traceability, Digital Product Passports, sustainability reporting, ERP or product lifecycle management systems • Experience with manufacturers, exporters, batteries, electronics, automotive, textiles or construction products • Experience developing a new territory or commercialising an emerging technology • Prior DPP experience is an advantage but not required — we're looking for people who can learn the proposition quickly and show how they've built productive partner relationships before. You'll work closely with leadership and product teams, own a defined commercial portfolio, and see a direct line between your work and business growth.

This role owns customer invoicing (Dynamics and Coretax e-Faktur) and customer receipt posting/settlement and plays a key role in preparing for and supporting the Indonesia entity's statutory audit, drawing on prior audit exposure (company-side or auditor-side). Responsibilities

Accounts Payable (Indonesia)

Own day-to-day AP operations for the Indonesia entity, including invoice verification, data entry, and payment processing.
Ensure timely and accurate processing of vendor invoices, employee expense claims, and related payments in accordance with company policies.
Manage AP-related month-end closing activities, including accruals, prepayments, and reconciliations, aligned with the group close timeline.
Monitor vendor aging reports and proactively resolve outstanding invoices and discrepancies.
Manage vendor onboarding, documentation, and query resolution.
Prepare supporting schedules and documentation for AP-related accounts, including Fixed Assets.

Accounts Receivable & Customer Invoicing (Indonesia)

Own end-to-end customer invoicing for the Indonesia entity, including issuance of Dynamics invoices and Coretax tax invoices (e-Faktur).
Post and settle customer receipts in Dynamics on a timely and accurate basis, ensuring correct application against open invoices.
Prepare AR aging reports, monitor outstanding customer balances with Finance Manager or Credit Collection team where needed.
Ensure invoicing and receipt records are properly documented and reconciled to support monthly close and reporting.

Tax, Compliance & Audit

Manage local tax reporting (VAT and withholding), maintaining accurate documentation and liaising directly with the external tax consultant.
Ensure compliance with local regulations, tax requirements, internal financial controls, and accounting standards.
Take primary responsibility for preparing supporting schedules and documentation for the statutory audit.

Regional Support (Malaysia)

Provide part-time, dedicated support to Malaysia accounting activities as a shared resource, with scope and time allocation to be defined based on business needs.

General

Work with internal stakeholders to ensure proper documentation, approvals, and coding of transactions.
Liaise with vendors, customers, and external parties on payment and invoice-related matters.
Perform other ad hoc finance and administrative tasks as assigned.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; Brevet Pajak or equivalent tax certification is an advantage.
Approximately 5–7 years of relevant accounting or finance experience, with solid exposure to both AP and AR.
Audit experience is required — either from the company side (preparing audit schedules, liaising directly with auditors) or the auditor side (public accounting firm).
Strong working knowledge of Indonesian tax and invoicing requirements, including e-Faktur/Coretax, VAT, and withholding tax.
Experience with ERP systems required; hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics strongly preferred.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables and lookups.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with willingness to take on cross-border/shared-resource responsibilities.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including direct liaison with auditors and tax consultants; comfortable working in a fast-paced, multi-cultural regional setup.
Good communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia.

Our founding vision is to make water analysis better—faster, simpler, greener, and more informative. We accomplish this through teamwork, customer partnerships, passionate experts, and reliable, easy-to-use solutions.

As part of our team and the broader Veralto network, you'll be part of a unique work environment where purpose meets possibility: where you'll make an immediate, measurable impact on a global scale by enabling the world's everyday water needs, and where you'll have opportunities to foster your professional development and fuel your career growth.

Competitive compensation package
Flexible working arrangements
Professional onboarding and training opportunities
Career coaching and development programs
Collaborative and supportive international team environment
Comprehensive health and wellbeing benefits
Opportunities for growth within a global organization

About The Role

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Sales Operations & Incentive Compensation, the Variable Compensation Analyst is responsible for administering and optimizing Hach's variable compensation programs across the European sales organization. This role serves as the system owner and subject matter expert for commission operations, ensuring accurate and compliant incentive processing while driving continuous improvement through data analysis and system enhancements. The successful candidate will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Finance, and Sales Enablement teams to deliver actionable insights, improve compensation processes, and support strategic business objectives.

This position is part of the Sales Operations organization and will be remote within APAC, with a strong preference for candidates based in Indonesia.

In this role, a typical day will look like

Administer the end-to-end variable compensation process, including commission calculations, payouts, adjustments, quota management, and case resolution.
Own and optimize the Oracle Fusion Incentive Compensation (FIC) platform, including system configuration, governance, enhancements, and long-term roadmap planning.
Serve as the primary subject matter expert for commission processing and incentive plan administration, providing guidance to stakeholders across the business.
Analyze commission-related inquiries and system performance data to identify trends, resolve root causes, and implement process improvements.
Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance to evaluate compensation plan effectiveness and recommend data-driven enhancements.
Support commission forecasting, accruals, and financial planning activities through collaboration with Finance teams.
Ensure compliance with SOX requirements, internal controls, and audit standards while supporting internal and external audits.
Develop reporting and analytical insights that help leadership assess compensation program performance and align incentives with business goals.

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
3+ years of experience in compensation, commissions administration, revenue operations, FP&A, sales operations, or a related analytical business function.
Experience administering variable compensation or incentive programs, including commission calculations and payment processes.
Hands-on experience with incentive compensation systems or enterprise commission management platforms.
Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with large datasets.
Experience using business intelligence or data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
Strong understanding of financial controls, compliance requirements, and process governance within a business environment.

About Hach & Veralto

Hach is proud to be part of the Water Quality segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto's vibrant global network of 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you'll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we're Safeguarding the World's Most Vital Resources™—and building rewarding careers along the way.

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

description:
ATech Solution builds and releases minimum viable products (MVPs) quickly. We’re looking for an experienced, hands‐on product marketer to help us decide which ideas deserve further investment. You’ll speak directly with potential customers, run online and offline campaigns, and produce videos that show our products in action. Your findings will help the team decide what to improve, pursue, or stop.

What you’ll do

• Before a launch, identify the customer segment, the problem we think we’re solving, and what we need to learn. Recruit potential users for interviews and demos. Find out how they handle the problem today, how often it occurs, what it costs them, and what would make them switch.
• Choose a meaningful signal for each MVP, such as a pilot commitment, a paid trial, or repeat use. Collect feedback from people who adopt the product and those who walk away. Give the team a concise recommendation on whether to invest further, change the product or audience, or stop development. Be clear about what the evidence supports and what’s still uncertain.
• Define the audience, message, channel, and success measure. Depending on where customers are easiest to reach, you might run a targeted email campaign, arrange a partner demo, or organize a small in‐person product trial. Track what happens after the initial contact.
• Script, storyboard, record, and edit product demos, explainers, and campaign videos. Make the customer’s problem and the product’s value clear. Adapt the footage, pacing, audio, and captions for the audience and channel.
• Review working MVPs for visual consistency, layout, wording, and usability. Work with developers on focused improvements, especially where testing shows that users get confused or abandon a task.
• Keep up with emerging tools and techniques, test them on real projects, and adopt the ones that improve speed or quality. Check AI‐assisted research summaries against the original feedback and verify that generated creative accurately represents the product.

What you’ll bring

• Hands‐on experience marketing early‐stage products, including a project where customer research changed a launch or product decision.
• Practical market research skills, from recruiting participants and conducting interviews to interpreting campaign and product usage data.
• A portfolio of marketing videos you personally helped script, shoot or record, and edit, plus experience delivering campaigns from concept through measurement.
• Strong visual judgment and practical UI/UX skills. You can improve an existing interface and communicate the changes clearly to developers.
• Demonstrated proficiency with current AI tools for creative and design work. You can show where you used them, what you corrected, and how they improved the finished result.
• Fluent spoken English for customer interviews, live demos, and team discussions. The ability to speak Cantonese or Mandarin is a major advantage. You’ll work remotely from Indonesia.

How to apply

Please share your CV, one finished marketing video link, and a brief example of a product or campaign decision you helped make using customer evidence. Tell us what you needed to learn, what people actually said or did, and what you recommended as a result. For the video, identify your contribution and where AI tools were part of your workflow.
title: Senior Product Marketing Specialist

Add accurate subtitles, on-screen text, music, sound effects and supporting visuals. Adjust audio, colour and framing for a polished, consistent result. A good understanding of hooks, storytelling, pacing and audience retention. The ability to create natural, engaging videos from everyday footage, conversations and walkthroughs. Proficiency in editing software such as Insta 360 Studio, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or CapCut. description:
Who Are We?

RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.

We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.

RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.

Role Overview

Indonesia is the largest market in Southeast Asia and a priority growth market for RZR. We are hiring our first in-market seller in Indonesia to build the book of business, define the ICP, and shape how RZR goes to market across the country.

Reporting to the Head of Sales, INSEA, you will own the full sales cycle with Indonesian app marketers, consumer brands and agencies, working closely with our Growth, Analytics, Marketing and Product teams. You sell a full performance stack — user acquisition, retargeting and CTV — to Indonesia's fastest-growing app companies, with hands-on support from RZR's pre-sales and launch teams.

Key Responsibilities

Own the full sales cycle — from account identification and outreach to contract, launch and handoff — for new RZR customers in Indonesia
Present RZR's UA, retargeting and CTV solutions to decision makers at app-first companies (e-commerce, fintech & digital lending, digital banks, on-demand services, gaming, consumer apps)
Build relationships with Jakarta-based media and performance agencies to win agency-led budgets
Build and maintain a tiered target account list using the INSEA account prioritization framework, and keep pipeline and forecast current in CRM
Partner with Growth and Analytics to scope test plans, agree KPIs and launch new customers successfully
Localize RZR's pitch and case studies for Indonesian clients, working with Marketing on Bahasa Indonesia collateral
Represent RZR at Indonesian and regional industry events
Meet and exceed quarterly new business targets

Required Skills And Experience

5+ years of sales experience in programmatic or mobile advertising in Indonesia, including 3+ years selling performance solutions (UA, retargeting, DSP, ad networks) to app marketers
Professional fluency in Bahasa Indonesia and English — required for this role
A named list of accounts in Indonesia you can bring to RZR, backed by current relationships with growth / UA decision makers and agency performance leads
Track record of closing new logos and meeting or exceeding quota — with numbers to show it
Working knowledge of MMPs and attribution, CPI / CPA / ROAS models, retargeting and Android-first supply
Comfortable working as the only seller in-market, with a regional manager and remote cross-functional support

Nice to have:

Experience selling retargeting or re-engagement solutions
Relationships in e-commerce, fintech and gaming
Experience with CTV or connected-device advertising in Indonesia

The RZR Code

Our Values

Our values define the company we want to be. They guide the decisions we make, the environment we create, and how we treat customers and each other.

Win with Customers: We don't call it a win unless our clients win too. We earn long-term trust by putting their success at the center.
One Team: No team wins when the company loses. We optimize for the company, not our function.
Challenge with Respect: We say what we think and challenge ideas regardless of title. We are direct without being disrespectful.
Learn Forward: Thoughtful experiments can fail; failing to learn from them cannot. Share what you learn.

Our Competencies

Our competencies define what we expect from each of us. They describe the behaviors and capabilities we demonstrate in our day-to-day work.

Extreme Ownership: Own the outcome end to end, including problems you didn't create.
Courage: Speak up, make hard calls, and take thoughtful risks.
Move Fast: Act with urgency and decide with the information available.
Curiosity: Ask why, look for better ways, and keep learning.
Drive for Excellence: Set a high bar for quality and keep raising it.
Deliver Results: Focus on outcomes that move the business forward.
Proactive Communication: Share information early, before anyone has to ask.

title: Senior Forestry Specialist
description:
Are you an experienced forestry auditor who enjoys combining technical certification work with building strong client relationships? Do you want to help forest managers and companies across Indonesia and the Asia Pacific region strengthen responsible forestry practices? If so, this role could be the right fit for you.

What You Can Expect

Preferred by Nature is looking for a Senior Forestry Specialist based in Indonesia to manage, audit and administer our forestry certification and verification services in Indonesia and the wider Asia Pacific region. Working with internationally recognised standards such as FSC Forest Management, FSC and PEFC Chain of Custody, SBP and Preferred by Nature’s own certification, you will lead audits, review the work of other auditors, manage a client portfolio and drive sales and market development. As one of the faces of Preferred by Nature in the region, you will play a key role in growing our forestry portfolio while keeping the quality of our audits high.

Working with us is never routine, so in your first year you can expect the following areas to be central to your work.

Conduct forestry certification and verification audits for assigned clients, including on-site visits, remote evaluations and report writing within agreed timeframes and quality requirements.
Act as task manager for your client portfolio, covering client support, audit budgeting, planning and scheduling, and keeping certification and verification records up to date.
Carry out quality reviews of audit reports, including technical review and certification or verification decisions within your qualifications.
Lead sales processes with potential clients, from presentations and scoping to preparing service proposals.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and stakeholders, providing excellent customer service together with the Asia Pacific team.
Support the development of the forestry certification market in Indonesia and across the region.
Ensure efficiency, quality control and adherence to Preferred by Nature’s operational, certification and verification protocols.

Your first year with us:

Within Three Months, You Will

Build a strong understanding of Preferred by Nature’s forestry certification and verification services, internal systems and procedures.
Get to know your assigned client portfolio in Indonesia and establish working relationships with the Asia Pacific team.
Begin conducting audits and task management for assigned clients, and start the qualification process for our schemes.

Within six months, you will:

Independently lead audits and manage your client portfolio, from planning and budgeting through to reporting.
Prepare service proposals and take part in client presentations and sales meetings with potential clients.
Progress towards quality reviewer qualifications for the key standards in your portfolio.

Within twelve months, you will:

Hold qualifications as auditor, quality reviewer and task manager for your assigned forestry schemes.
Manage a stable and growing client portfolio with consistent audit quality and strong client satisfaction.
Contribute actively to market development, identifying and following up on new business opportunities in Indonesia and the Asia Pacific region.

Important that you:

Hold a bachelor’s degree in forestry, natural resource management, environmental science or a related field.
Bring at least four years of relevant experience in the forestry industry, a certification body, an NGO or another international organisation.
Are qualified as an auditor under FSC Forest Management, FSC Chain of Custody, PEFC Chain of Custody and/or SBP.
Are fluent in written and spoken English and Bahasa Indonesia.
Have good communication and client management skills, and feel confident presenting to clients and preparing proposals.
Possess strong analytical and report-writing skills.
Have strong self-management skills, with the ability to stay focused and follow through on commitments.
Are comfortable travelling within Indonesia and the Asia Pacific region for on-site audits.
Are proficient in MS Office applications, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Would also be great, but not necessary, if you:

Have experience as a quality reviewer or task manager in a certification body.
Bring experience in sales or business development within a certification or consulting environment.
Have worked in an international, multicultural team.

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you!

What Sets Us Apart

Global work culture
High degree of flexibility - remote work, work from home.
An in-depth onboarding and professional training that prepares you with the right skills and knowledge to thrive in this role.
Excellent opportunities for growth and professional development
Potential future international travel opportunities
A friendly, international team of colleagues, with a pleasant work environment
20 days of vacation leave per year

Preferred by Nature is a non-profit, mission driven organisation that works for sustainable land management and climate-friendly solutions. With 350+ employees and a network of local experts, we develop practical solutions to drive positive impacts in production landscapes and supply chains in 100+ countries. We focus on forest and climate impact commodities and related sectors.

title: Financial Planner | Professional Career Growth | Full-Time & Part-Time Opportunities
description:

Rencana Bijak Academy is a professional development program by PT Rencana Bijak Indonesia, a professional financial consulting company built on the Certified Financial Planner (CFP®) standard. The program opens a career path toward becoming a Certified Financial Planner (CFP®), including an individual insurance agency practice with our partner insurance companies, licensed by AAJI and/or AASI and registered with the Indonesian Financial Services Authority (OJK) under the applicable agency structure.

This is a performance-based business opportunity, not a salaried employment role. In return, you get greater flexibility to manage your schedule, work from anywhere, and build a long-term Financial Planning business with uncapped income potential.

You may pursue this opportunity either by building a full-time practice through our Career Switch Program (CSP) or alongside your current profession through our Dual Career Program (DCP).

About the Opportunity

At Rencana Bijak, we are committed to helping individuals and families build stronger financial foundations, planning before products, education before decisions.

As a Financial Planner and a business partner of related insurance companies, your primary focus is to educate clients, understand their financial goals, develop personalized financial plans, and help them implement those plans through appropriate financial solutions, including insurance products from our partner insurance companies when relevant.

What You'll Do

Improve financial literacy through education and consultation.
Understand clients' financial goals and priorities.
Develop personalized Financial Plans.
Recommend appropriate financial solutions, including insurance products from our partner insurance companies when relevant.
Build long-term client relationships based on trust and professional advice.
Continuously develop your expertise as a Financial Planning professional.

Choose Your Career Path

Both paths go through the same structured onboarding: Rencana Bijak Academy OVT + 16 mentoring sessions, mentorship, and business development.

Career Switch Program (CSP): build your Financial Planning practice full-time, with an intensive onboarding pace.
Dual Career Program (DCP): start your practice alongside your current profession, with a flexible schedule.

What You'll Gain

A proven system to build your own Financial Planning business as a business partner of related insurance companies.
Certification pathway AWP → RFP → CFP®, with scholarship opportunities for eligible participants.
Access to the Rencana Bijak fee-based consulting ecosystem for certified CFPs (our Choice of Client model, where clients opt for fee-based consultations).
One-on-one mentorship, practical business coaching, and a supportive professional network.
Flexible working arrangements with control over your time and location.

Already a CFP®? This Unlocks for You

• Paid 1-on-1 consultations: Deliver fee-based financial consultations through the Rencana Bijak platform (your clients, your schedule, paid per session).

• Paid B2B teaching: Serve as an instructor in our corporate financial literacy training programs, with honorarium per program.

• Webinar speaking (pro bono): Speak at Rencana Bijak educational webinars, an education contribution that helps you earn your CPD (Continuing Professional Development) points under FPSB.

• Certification fee compensation: CFPs who complete the program requirements receive reimbursement of previously incurred CFP® certification costs, per our scholarship policy.

Who We're Looking For

Indonesian citizen, eligible for AAJI/AASI licensing.
Bachelor's degree.
Passionate about personal finance or wealth management.
Enjoy helping others make better financial decisions.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Committed to continuous learning and professional growth.
Value entrepreneurship and long-term relationship building.
Previous experience in sales or customer service is an advantage but not required.

If you want to become a business partner of related insurance companies, build a meaningful profession, grow a long-term Financial Planning business, and make a positive impact on the financial well-being of individuals and families, we encourage you to apply.

description:
About the Role

We're looking for an accountant who wants to run accounting on an AI-native platform, not just use one. You'll operate our clients' books on InterOpera's platform: reviewing and approving what our AI agents prepare, closing the month and delivering financial statements. You'll also be the accountant's voice inside our product team.

On the project, you'll work with our product and engineering team to turn accounting rules into system logic for our clients. You'll also work directly with clients to understand their requirements, and may take on project management where needed.

This role suits someone who has a solid accounting foundation, enjoys working with technology, is comfortable working with clients, and We're looking for an accountant who wants to run accounting on an AI-native platform, not just use one. You'll operate our clients' books on InterOpera's platform: reviewing and approving what our AI agents prepare, closing the month and delivering financial statements. You'll also be the accountant's voice inside our product team.

Key Responsibilities

Client Accounting Operations on Our Platform

Run the monthly accounting cycle for assigned client entities on our platform: document intake, AI-prepared journal entries, bank reconciliations, trial balance and financial statements.

Review the AI agents' work in the review queue: approve, correct or reject entries, mappings and matches, and record why.

Close each client's month on the agreed timeline and sign off the figures before they reach the client.

Resolve the exceptions the AI cannot resolve (unmatched bank lines, unknown counterparties, missing documents) and request missing items from clients.

Keep a clear audit trail: every figure traceable to its source document, and every rule change approved by someone other than its author.

Product Feedback & Rulebook

Use the platform every day as its most demanding user, and report what slows you down, what the AI gets wrong and what's missing.

Feed your corrections back as rules and examples so the AI gets the same case right next time.

Join product reviews with engineering: challenge designs from the accountant's side and propose changes to workflows, screens and reports.

Track AI accuracy for your clients (e.g. share of entries approved without correction, recurring error types) and report the trends.

Administration

Maintain and organise corporate records, contracts, agreements and company documents digitally.

Help prepare board and shareholder resolutions, meeting minutes and other corporate secretarial documents.

Support statutory and regulatory compliance (e.g. ACRA filings).

Handle HR administration: onboarding and offboarding, employee records, leave tracking and employment contracts.

Support monthly payroll preparation and related documents, including payslips.

Coordinate with external parties, including the corporate secretary, auditors, tax consultants, banks and vendors.

Manage vendor administration, subscriptions and procurement documents.

Handle general office administration and ad-hoc requests from management.

Finance

Assist in processing vendor and supplier payments, and prepare payment documents for approval.

Support accounts payable and receivable, including invoicing, collections follow-up and aging reports.

Check and process employee expense claims and reimbursements.

Help prepare budgets, forecasts and budget-vs-actual analysis.

Help prepare financial data and reports for management.

Support tax administration, including documents and supporting data for tax filings (e.g. corporate income tax with IRAS).

Accounting

Assist in recording daily transactions and journal entries in the accounting system.

Help prepare month-end adjustments (accruals, prepayments, amortisation, depreciation).

Assist with bank, intercompany, vendor and customer reconciliations.

Support month-end and year-end closing, including the trial balance and supporting schedules.

Help maintain the fixed asset and intangible asset registers.

Assist in preparing financial statements.

Help prepare audit schedules and supporting documents for the annual audit.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.

3-5 years of experience in accounting, finance or administration.

Solid understanding of accounting principles (double-entry, accruals, revenue recognition) and IFRS.

Has been the accountable reviewer of someone else's work (e.g. as a senior, auditor or fund accountant).

Writes clearly: explains an accounting treatment and a software bug equally well.

Handles confidential client financial data with care.

Hands-on experience with accounting systems (Xero, NetSuite, Accurate or similar).

Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills (e.g. lookups, pivot tables).

Tech-savvy: learns new software quickly and is comfortable with cloud-based tools (e.g. Google Workspace, Notion, Slack).

Uses AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude) to work more efficiently, and is interested in automating manual processes.

Logical, structured thinker who can explain accounting treatment step by step, to both engineers and clients.

Highly detail-oriented, with strong documentation habits.

Confident communicating with clients in English, both spoken and written.

Able to work independently and manage several priorities in a fast-paced startup.

Nice to Have

Fund accounting, real-estate / property reporting, or multi-entity and multi-currency accounting.

Has given structured feedback to a software vendor or worked closely with a product team.

Experience managing project timelines and tasks.

Professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACCA, CA, CPA), completed or in progress.

Experience implementing an accounting system or ERP, or working at a SaaS / tech company.

What Success Looks Like

Month 1:

Take over one client entity in your first week and close its month on your own within 10 business days, signing off the figures yourself. Close InterOpera's own month on the platform as well.

Months 2–3:

Own month-end close for 2–3 client entities, each signed off within 7 business days of month-end.

Month 6:

Own 5 client entities, each closed within 5 business days of receiving complete documents. The share of AI-prepared entries you approve without correction rises every month, and at least one of your issue reports ships as a product change each month.

What We Offer

The chance to help build an accounting software product from the ground up.

Direct exposure to clients and to product decisions.

A collaborative, flexible, fully digital work environment.

Why Join Us?

Work closely with leadership and make a direct impact on company operations and growth.

Gain hands-on exposure across finance, administration, HR, and systems management in a fast-scaling environment.

Be part of an AI-driven startup, where you’ll learn how emerging technologies are applied to real-world business operations.

Opportunity to grow with a dynamic, innovation-focused team that values initiative, adaptability, and collaboration.

JOB OVERVIEW

Palapa Corp mencari B2B Business Development Executive yang berorientasi pada pertumbuhan bisnis dan mampu membangun pipeline klien corporate secara proaktif.

Posisi ini bertanggung jawab mengidentifikasi potential clients, melakukan outreach dan prospecting, membangun relasi dengan decision makers, memahami kebutuhan inspeksi bangunan, menyusun proposal penawaran, melakukan negosiasi, serta mengembangkan kerja sama bisnis jangka panjang.

Target market mencakup pemilik, pengelola, dan perusahaan yang memiliki atau mengoperasikan aset properti seperti gedung perkantoran, pabrik, warehouse, ruko, commercial building, fasilitas industri, dan properti lainnya.

RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Business Development & Lead Generation

Mengidentifikasi dan memetakan potential clients serta target perusahaan sesuai segmentasi pasar.

2. Sales Process & Client Acquisition

Melakukan komunikasi awal, discovery meeting, presentasi, dan business meeting dengan calon klien.

Mengidentifikasi kebutuhan, pain points, kondisi aset, serta kebutuhan inspeksi calon klien.

Menjelaskan layanan, scope pekerjaan, value proposition, dan solusi inspeksi yang relevan.

Menindaklanjuti leads dan opportunities secara sistematis hingga tahap proposal, negosiasi, dan closing.

Mengelola proses sales secara end-to-end, mulai dari prospecting hingga kontrak atau purchase order.

3. Proposal, Quotation & Negotiation

Menyusun quotation, proposal bisnis, scope of work, dan penawaran komersial sesuai kebutuhan calon klien.

Berkoordinasi dengan tim teknis dan operasional untuk memastikan feasibility, scope, timeline, dan deliverables.

Melakukan negosiasi harga, terms of payment, scope pekerjaan, serta commercial terms.

Mengelola dokumen kerja sama seperti kontrak, MoU, vendor registration, purchase order, dan dokumen administrasi terkait.

4. Account Management & Partnership

Membangun dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan existing clients.

Mengembangkan repeat business, upselling, cross-selling, serta peluang inspeksi berkala.

Mengidentifikasi peluang kontrak jangka panjang dan recurring inspection.

Mengembangkan partnership dengan property management, facility management, property consultants, contractors, developers, dan perusahaan terkait.

5. Sales Pipeline & Reporting

Mengelola sales pipeline, CRM, database leads, serta seluruh aktivitas follow-up.

Menyusun laporan aktivitas, sales performance, forecast, dan pipeline secara berkala.

Melakukan analisis terhadap conversion rate, sales cycle, win-loss, serta efektivitas channel prospecting.

Mencapai target lead generation, meeting, quotation, revenue, dan closing yang ditetapkan perusahaan.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum S1 dari jurusan Business, Marketing, Management, Engineering, Property Management, atau bidang relevan lainnya.

Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2–4 tahun di bidang B2B Sales, Business Development, Corporate Sales, atau Account Management.

Terbiasa berkomunikasi dan melakukan presentasi kepada corporate clients maupun decision makers.

Memiliki kemampuan menyusun proposal, quotation, presentasi, dan dokumen penawaran bisnis.

Memiliki kemampuan negosiasi, komunikasi, networking, dan relationship management yang baik.

Terbiasa menggunakan CRM, Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint/Google Slides, LinkedIn, dan tools penjualan lainnya.

Memiliki kemampuan mengelola sales pipeline dan melakukan follow-up secara terstruktur.

Proaktif, persisten, mandiri, target-oriented, serta nyaman bekerja dengan target penjualan.

Memiliki kemampuan analitis untuk memahami kebutuhan klien dan mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis.

Bersedia melakukan business meeting, client visits, dan perjalanan dinas jika diperlukan.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Memiliki network atau pengalaman menjual kepada perusahaan di sektor property, construction, manufacturing, facility management, hospitality, commercial real estate, atau industrial sector.

Memiliki pengalaman menjual jasa B2B dengan proses sales cycle yang relatif panjang.

Memiliki kemampuan Bahasa Inggris bisnis yang baik.

title: CRO Content Manager, AI First
description: Ready to own a brand’s voice and build AI-powered content that turns customer insight into growth? Total annual cash compensation: Up to USD $132,000 + comprehensive benefits Base salary up to USD $120,000/year + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base Location: Remote — Global Potential career path: CRO Content Manager → Senior CRO Content Manager → Head of Content. Career progression that takes 4-5 years elsewhere can happen in 1-2 years here for high performers. The Opportunity Puffy is a technology-driven e-commerce business with over $1 billion in lifetime sales, powered by analytics, data and artificial intelligence. Our teams bring together software development, quality assurance, machine learning and AI, marketing, design, conversion rate optimisation, talent augmentation, HR, operations, legal, finance and customer success. As our CRO Content Manager, AI-First, you’ll own Puffy’s brand narrative, voice and conversion content strategy. Product detail pages and landing pages are your first priority, alongside brand guidance and messaging for email and social. You’ll report to the VP – Digital Experience & Conversion and manage a CRO Copywriter. This is a hands-on leadership role: you’ll write, build AI workflows, develop your copywriter and connect content decisions to commercial evidence. The Problems You’ll Own • Make a bold brand believable. Customers buy a high-consideration product online, often without trying it. Your content must answer purchase concerns and make confident claims credible through relevant evidence and a persuasive buying argument. • Turn content insight into repeatable learning. Build a content system that helps the team deliver stronger work with less rework. Make hypotheses clear before testing and use supported findings to improve subsequent content. What You’ll Own • Brand voice and conversion messaging: Set the message hierarchy, choose supporting evidence and write conversion copy. Turn technical product features, customer concerns and complex briefs into clear buying arguments. • Research and strategy: Build a research base covering customer concerns, purchase motivations, competitors and approved product claims. Use it to develop messaging angles and content hypotheses. • AI-powered content workflows: Build and operate workflows across research, strategy, copy, creative briefs, quality checks and experiment learning. Validate outputs for factual accuracy, substantiation and brand voice. • Content delivery across teams: Provide messaging, copy, briefs and brand standards for email and social. Channel owners retain planning, deployment and performance management. • Experiment learning: Work with CRO on copy variants and interpret results together. CRO owns test design, implementation, statistical analysis and the determination of results. Design owns visual execution and interaction design. • Copywriter development: Coach your CRO Copywriter and build reusable instructions, source packs and review standards so they can deliver independently. Agree priorities and success measures with your manager. Retain ownership of editorial decisions and final output, and follow the required specialist or legal review for relevant claims. What This Can Mean for Your Career • Own the message and the system behind it. Combine customer research, brand voice, conversion copy and AI workflow development in one role. • Build a body of work supported by evidence. Develop the judgement to explain why a message should work, what a test established and when the findings remain inconclusive. • Grow through broader responsibility. Work directly with your manager and partners in CRO and Design, while developing another writer and strengthening how the team delivers. In your first 12 months, you’ll develop the customer research base, messaging framework, content workflows and review standards behind this work. You’ll use experiment findings to refine the system and improve quality and turnaround while reducing avoidable rework. What You’ll Need • Demonstrated AI workflow capability is the primary hiring gate. Show workflows you personally built and used, their inputs, the outputs you improved, verification steps and resulting gains in quality, speed or business outcomes. Regular AI use alone is insufficient; candidates without this evidence will not progress. • Exceptional conversion copywriting and editorial judgement, supported by work that preserves brand voice, product accuracy and substantiated claims. • Evidence of creating or maintaining brand guidelines and resolving copy and visual inconsistencies with relevant owners. • The ability to simplify technical product features, customer concerns and complex briefs into persuasive buying arguments, including explaining what you omitted and why. • Proven content impact on business performance, with clear evidence of your contribution, measured results and what those results establish. • 6+ years of progressive content strategy and marketing experience, including at least 2 years directly managing and developing content teams. • The ability to translate leadership priorities and business goals into concrete creative strategies and execution plans. • Strong understanding of CRO, A/B testing and web analytics, including prioritising opportunities and interpreting findings with specialists. • The ability to build reusable working standards and coach others to deliver independently. • Flawless written and verbal English, with hands-on expertise in conversion copy and strategic documentation. • Willingness to work extended hours and weekends as needed. Good to Have • D2C e-commerce experience. • Understanding of US consumer psychology and messaging that addresses purchase scepticism. The Resources to Build On Puffy has been AI-first since December 2023. You’ll have company-provided AI tools, including ChatGPT and Claude, AI agents, bots, plugins, AI projects and automations through platforms such as n8n. You’ll also receive relevant department tools, data, assets and specialist support. Use them to automate routine work, test ideas and produce high-quality results, while retaining responsibility for editorial judgement and validation. The Puffy DNA We’re ambitious, fast-paced and focused on turning ideas into results. • Be the Owner: Take responsibility for outcomes and follow work through completion. • Execute with Urgency: Make thoughtful decisions quickly and act decisively. • Demand Excellence: Solve difficult problems and keep improving your craft. • Be AI-First: Use multi-turn AI conversations to challenge assumptions and improve your work. • Go All-In: Work together when the mission demands it. ✨ Your Compensation & Benefits 💰 Compensation • Up to USD $132,000 total annual cash compensation. • Base salary up to USD $120,000/year plus a monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base. • Annual salary review every January. 🏥 Health & Protection: • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (based on country of hire) 🌴 Time Off: • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) + Public holidays 💼 Work Environment: • AI-First organization with access to AI-native tool stack • Remote First: Work from the comfort of your home office • Learning & development opportunities • International team collaboration across 16+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily. 🏆 Rewards & Recognition: • Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats • Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company-wide celebration for exceptional contributions Ready to Put Your Expertise to Work? Click “Apply” to submit your application. Show us the content you’ve shaped, the AI workflows you’ve built and the results you can explain.

Build a consistent approach to typography, motion, sound and composition across our videos. Use AI to expand what you can create. Generate supporting visuals, voiceovers and other assets where they strengthen the work or speed up production. What you’ll bring A portfolio that shows your judgement. We want to see clear storytelling, deliberate pacing, strong visual choices and attention to detail. Strong editing and motion skills. You’re proficient in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro, with experience in After Effects or an equivalent motion design tool. An instinct for the opening. You know how to create interest in the first few seconds and sustain it through the rest of the video. The ability to simplify. You can find the central idea in a long recording or complex product demonstration and build a clear story around it. An ear for sound. You understand how music, silence, dialogue and sound effects influence the way a video feels. Comfort with AI creative tools. You can incorporate tools such as Runway, Kling, Sora or ElevenLabs into your workflow when useful. Experience with SaaS product videos, founder content, documentary storytelling or paid social ads is a plus. Why join Base360? Work directly with the founder. Help shape the stories behind the product and the business. Have meaningful creative ownership. Bring ideas, develop new formats and influence how Base360 looks and sounds. See your work make an impact. Your videos will support product launches, marketing campaigns and conversations with potential customers. Grow with the company. There’s an opportunity to take on broader creative leadership and help build a video team. Competitive salary and performance incentives. Remote work with an ambitious, entrepreneurial team. How we work We move quickly, communicate directly and take responsibility for what we deliver. You’ll be expected to bring ideas, make creative decisions, meet deadlines and improve your work through feedback. Priorities can change, and experimentation is part of the job. This role suits someone who enjoys taking initiative, cares about both the craft and the outcome, and wants to keep raising the quality of their work.

description:
About the job

DevOps and platform engineer for UK production systems, remote from South-East Asia.

You will own and evolve our production AWS platform, supporting high-traffic PHP (Laravel) and Node.js applications with a focus on reliability, security, and developer productivity. This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership.

What you will do

Design, build, and operate AWS infrastructure using Terraform (VPCs, ECS/Fargate, RDS/Aurora, ElastiCache, S3, CloudFront, WAF, Secrets Manager, IAM).

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), including automated testing, Docker image builds, and zero-downtime deployments.

Operate and improve observability (CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, structured logging, alerting, dashboards).

Implement and maintain security controls: patching, secrets management, least-privilege IAM, WAF rules, and backup/DR.

Improve developer experience: local environment parity, preview environments, documentation, and tooling.

Own incident response for infrastructure, including on-call participation and blameless postmortems.

Drive cost optimisation and performance tuning across AWS services.

Must-have

5+ years in DevOps / platform / SRE roles.

Deep AWS experience, especially ECS/Fargate, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudFront, IAM.

Strong Terraform (IaC) and Docker skills.

Experience with GitHub Actions and CI/CD best practices.

Solid Linux, networking, and scripting skills (Bash/Python).

Experience supporting PHP (Laravel) and Node.js applications in production.

Strong understanding of security best practices.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Self-motivated, organised, and comfortable working remotely across time zones.

Nice to have

Experience with queue systems (SQS/Sidekiq/Redis) and caching strategies.

Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, or similar observability tools.

Experience with multi-region / multi-account AWS setups.

Knowledge of cost management tools and FinOps practices.

What we offer

Fully remote from South-East Asia (Bali / Indonesia preferred).

Competitive salary in IDR: 21,000,000 - 31,000,000 per month, depending on experience.

Flexible working hours with core overlap with UK team (14:00 - 18:00 WIB).

Annual performance bonus.

Hardware and home office budget.

Opportunities to grow into a Lead / Head of Platform role.

How to apply

Email your CV to: ••••@thoughtgears.co.uk

Only candidates who meet the must-have criteria will be contacted.

description:
About the Team

ShopeePay is Monee's mobile wallet, providing users with fast and secure digital payment services across Southeast Asia. As the digital payments arm of Monee, ShopeePay has evolved from enabling in-app purchases to becoming a trusted everyday payment solution, including offline payments at merchants and online payments across platforms.

As a Business Product Manager for the ShopeePay app, you will own the growth of our mobile wallet, covering app install, activation, engagement, and transaction conversion. You will define and prioritise a growth roadmap for ShopeePay’s mobile app, design user acquisition and activation mechanics, and drive product-led initiatives that improve conversion across the funnel. Working closely with engineering, design, data and business teams, you will turn user insights and data into features and experiments that deliver measurable growth for ShopeePay.

Job Description

Design and manage features and mechanics that drive ShopeePay app installs
Own initiatives that convert installed users into monthly active users, including onboarding flows, re-engagement triggers, habit-forming features and retention mechanics
Develop features that convert active users into monthly transacting users, including reducing friction in the first transaction, incentive structures and use-case expansion to drive repeat transaction behaviour
Identify and test new growth levers, such as new feature concepts and engagement mechanics, through structured experimentation (A/B testing and pilot rollouts)
Analyse the performance of existing growth features, diagnose underperformance, and iterate on mechanics, User Experience (UX) and incentive design to improve conversion at each funnel stage
Present the growth roadmap, experiment results and strategic recommendations to leadership (e.g. Director and senior product stakeholders)

Requirements

3-5 years of Product Management experience, ideally in consumer apps, fintech, e-commerce or growth-focused product roles
Track record of driving measurable growth in install, activation or engagement metrics
Analytical skills to interpret funnel and cohort data to make product decisions
Experience designing and running A/B tests and translating results into product iterations
Familiarity with growth loops, funnel optimisation and behavioural and incentive design
Proficiency in Figma, with the ability to independently design, prototype and iterate on User Experience (UX) and User Interface (UI) flows and mockups to communicate feature concepts to design and engineering teams
Stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally across engineering, design, data and business teams
Experience in digital payments or wallets, e-commerce cross-sell mechanics or Southeast Asian markets is a plus
title: Business Product Manager, ShopeePay

description: Deskripsi pekerjaan Information Security PT Terra Drone Indonesia Information Security Officer (Remote) About the Role Terra Drone Indonesia is looking for a motivated and enthusiastic individual to join our team as an Information Security Officer. In this role, you will support the information security activities of our sister company, Terra Drone Arabia (Saudi Arabia), by assisting with information security practices, ISO 27001 implementation, documentation, and compliance activities. This opportunity is open to fresh graduates and entry-level candidates with a technical background who are eager to learn and build a career in Information Security.
